name: CIMC GD32F470VET6 V2.0
coordinates: Measured approximate centers on official photograph scaled to 1000x650; header row order is verified. These are not PCB fabrication coordinates or manufacturer pin numbers.
notes: V2.0 header labels are verified against official photographs. Full V2.0 schematic has not been located.
Do not infer V2.0 copper routing from the V1.0 schematic. V2 USART2 PD8/PD9 differs from V1 PB10/PB11.
LED and KEY terminals are independent connectors; demo GPIO mappings are visible added jumpers, never immutable board copper.
LED/KEY polarity, OLED MCU pins and unphotographed internal routing are code-supported model assumptions, not full V2 hardware verification.
NC terminals are disabled. Power pins are not GPIO.

mcu.evidence: S5 official exact part selector + S6 local Keil GD32F470VE target CPU declaration
notes: TCM SRAM is data-bus only; instruction fetch from TCM must be rejected.
Additional 4 KiB backup SRAM at 0x40024000 is a separate peripheral-domain resource, not main SRAM.
Flash program/erase writes require the flash controller; ordinary store instructions must not silently alter flash.
